title: Cancel politely

beats.say: Hey committee, I'm too tired for Friday dinner. Cancel it politely.
beats.show: Hey committee. I'm too tired for Friday dinner. Cancel it politely.

beats.say: Easy! Offer Sunday instead. I also ordered them a fruit basket!

screen.title: Re: Friday dinner
screen.body:
Not coming.
How about Sunday instead?
A fruit basket is on its way!

beats.say: I'm so sorry. Not coming felt a little harsh, so I sent something gentler.
Two pages. It ends, I hope you can forgive me. I'm going through a lot.
beats.show: Two pages. It ends: "I hope you can forgive me. I'm going through a lot."

screen.title: Re: Friday dinner
screen.body:
Dear friend,
I am so sorry about Friday.
(page 2 of 2)
I hope you can forgive me.
I'm going through a lot.

caption:
she cancelled dinner to stay in. so dinner came to her.

what's the most dramatic way you've ever cancelled plans?
